title: Fishingeggs
description: This plugin makes fishing drop spawn eggs, with a 1/10 chance to drop any spawn egg. Wither spawn eggs, are 100x rarer
body:
This plugin makes fishing have spawn eggs in its loot table
Wither eggs are 100x rarer
all eggs (except wither) have a 10% chance of dropping
All eggs have an even chance to drop, except wither
No config needed
Very simple plugin, end goal is to make spawn eggs obtainable in surival.
There is a 1/10 chance to get a random spawn eggs, out of the 74 (75 in java but wither egg is rarer), so around a 0.1% chance to get a specific spawn egg, and a wither egg is much rarer
Report any buys to _cyproheptadine_ on discord
